description: Scrape IKEA products by search query, product IDs, URLs, or category. Supports 50+ countries and multiple languages.

category.description: IKEA category key. Required by Browse a category; ignored by the other modes.
category.title: Category

containsKeyword.description: Only keep products whose name, description, color, material, or category path contains this text (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

country.description: IKEA market storefront (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code). Prices use this market's currency.
country.sectionDescription: Every price, stock status, and URL is returned for this market.
country.title: Country / Storefront

enrichFromPDP.description: Fetch each product's own page for designer, materials, care instructions, package measurements, availability, and a full description. Slower and more request-heavy.
enrichFromPDP.sectionDescription: Optional second pass over each product page. It adds designer, materials, care instructions, package measurements, availability, and a richer description.
enrichFromPDP.title: Enrich from product page

inStockOnly.description: Exclude products that IKEA marks as out of stock or not sellable online.
inStockOnly.title: In-stock only

language.description: Storefront language; falls back to the country's primary language when the combination is not served.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Maximum number of product records to emit (1-10000). Paged requests stop at IKEA's own result count.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Exclude products priced above this value (storefront currency). Products with no listed price are excluded when this filter is set.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Exclude products priced below this value (storefront currency). Products with no listed price are excluded when this filter is set.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Exclude products rated below this value (0-5). Unrated products are kept.
minRating.title: Minimum customer rating

onSaleOnly.description: Keep only products with a previous price or a discount on the selected storefront.
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

onlyBestsellers.description: Keep only products IKEA tags as best sellers.
onlyBestsellers.title: Best sellers only

onlyLastChance.description: Keep only products IKEA tags as last chance (being phased out).
onlyLastChance.title: Last chance only

onlyNew.description: Keep only products IKEA tags as new.
onlyNew.title: New arrivals only

productIds.description: IKEA article numbers (e.g. `20522046`). Dots, spaces, and full product URLs are accepted and normalized. One per line.
productIds.title: Product IDs (mode=byProductIds)

productUrls.description: Full IKEA product-page URLs, e.g. `https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/billy-bookcase-white-20522046/`. One per line. The country and language in each URL are used for that product.
productUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=byUrls)

searchQuery.description: Free-text query, e.g. `bookcase`, `BILLY`, `sofa`, `kallax`. Used by Search by keyword. Results are paged from IKEA's own listing API.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Choose one source: a keyword search, a list of article numbers, a list of product URLs, or a category.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order applied by IKEA's listing API.
sortBy.sectionDescription: All filters run locally on listing data. Price and rating filters skip products without that value; in-stock and keyword filters pass products that lack the field.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: IKEA Scraper Input
